title: Remove active-session proxy refusals from gate credit while retaining exact evidence and real heavy-run serialization
outcome: Implement Greg's directive to eliminate active/inactive-session ceremony and false gate-credit refusals. Serialize actual heavy runs and preserve exact-input evidence; ordinary session activity must not waste an otherwise valid completed gate.
acceptance: Gate eligibility and completed-run credit do not depend on whether a session is active or inactive, its presence, its worktree name, ordinary mail, idle turns or unrelated activity. No replacement session/worktree proxy is introduced.

Exact-input fingerprint, source/evidence integrity and actual heavy-run serialization remain enforced; contention refusal requires demonstrated resource conflict affecting the gate rather than assumed conflict from session activity.

Deterministic regression tests reproduce the reported false refusal and cover harmless activity at launch and during settlement alongside true input/evidence changes and actual conflicting heavy runs. The first refused run and unchanged successful retry retain honest provenance.

The final exact input passes applicable focused checks and the maintained full gate, has the required independent vendor review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding, and receives fresh independent acceptance.
